title: Spend a winter night at Old Faithful
description: Ride a snowcoach into Yellowstone’s interior, where ordinary cars do not reach Old Faithful Snow Lodge in winter. From that warm base, step out into quiet snow and watch steam rise from geysers against the cold air. Staying overnight gives you time to experience the basin after day visitors have gone, then return to the lodge for dinner and a rest.
teaser: Reach Yellowstone’s snowy interior by snowcoach.
goodToKnow: Confirm lodge dates, snowcoach transfers and conditions on paths before reserving.
whyItMightDelightYou: The park feels different when the road ends and the geyser basin becomes your neighborhood for the night.
